name: Ekho vidvertykh pryznan
source:
Tormented by both his wife's death and creative stagnation, renowned artist Dorian McGrath finds solace in whiskey and conversation with his friend Lester, who in turn struggles with loneliness, a fear of birds, and being laid off from his job. Their friendly encounter turns into a confession of insecurity and discontent, but it also reveals a ray of unity as they recognize their shared loneliness and seek solace in each other.

[Translated from [url=https://nana-nanachi.itch.io/enchoes]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
著名艺术家多里安·麦格拉思 (Dorian McGrath) 饱受妻子去世和创作停滞的双重折磨，在威士忌和与朋友莱斯特 (Lester) 的交谈中找到了慰藉，而莱斯特则与孤独、对鸟类的恐惧和失业作斗争。他们的友好相遇变成了对不安全感和不满的坦白，但也透露出一丝团结，因为他们认识到自己共同的孤独，并在彼此身上寻求安慰。

[译自[url=https://nana-nanachi.itch.io/enchoes]itch.io[/url]]
